info.name: Tazkara
info.description: End to end flow for the Tazkara platform. Start the container with `docker compose up --build`, then run the folders in order with the Collection Runner. Every request goes through the gateway on port 8080 unless noted. Requests marked [verify path] use assumed Event endpoint paths.
